description: Lifesteal brawler - the Harvester passive turns a share of everything you deal into healing, Doomrend stops the target stabilising, and Slaughter finishes anything under 35%.
_source_note: Built from reference/coa_sidekick/SPEC_reaper__harvest.txt: 'Closest to Blood Death Knight ... Your own damage is your healing, packaged in an AoE cleave-and-leech loop.' CoA rates it PvE B / PvP C and recommends it for levelling. The tree spends most of its points on the three things the reference says carry the spec - the Harvester leech, Doomrend's anti-heal, and the Slaughter execute - and the reference's own named weakness ('No blink, no vanish, no bubble, no CC-break in the spec line') is honoured by leaving every defensive out in the class kit.

nodes.name: Bountiful Harvest
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Reap and Murder by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the damage of Reap and Murder by 25%'. Split across 5 ranks to reach the same total.

nodes.name: Sanguine Harvester
nodes.description: Increases your haste by 1 per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your melee haste by 10%', 2 ranks. Frontier's haste is a flat rating, and 1.0/rank is the shipped per-rank value across every tree.

nodes.name: Crimson Wraith
nodes.description: Increases your critical strike damage by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your critical stike damage by 10%'. crit_damage_physical is a FRACTION of the base hit.

nodes.name: Callous Soul
nodes.description: Increases your armor penetration by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the amount of armor Soulrend causes you to ignore by 10%'. There is no per-ability armour-ignore key, so it is general armour penetration - which the spec's stat priority asks for anyway ('Strength > Armor Penetration > Critical Strike'). armor_penetration_pct is one of the ten POINTS keys, hence 2.0 for 2%.

nodes.name: Red Wake
nodes.description: Your critical strikes have a 20% chance per rank to harvest a Soul.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Direct damage critical strikes now generate an additional Soul Fragment.' A multi-rank proc scales its CHANCE by points spent (_sync_talent_procs) and not its payload, so the tooltip says chance per rank.

nodes.name: Maw Knight
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of Doomrend by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the critical strike chance of Doomrend by 5%'. ability_<id>_crit is in percentage POINTS - it is added straight onto crit_chance.

nodes.name: Doomer
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Doomrend and Slaughter by 6% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the damage of Doomrend and Slaughter by 30%'. Five ranks of 6% is the same 30%.

nodes.name: Dark Fate
nodes.description: Reduces the Mana cost of Crow's Harvest by 6% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Reduces the cost of Crow's Harvest by -10 Runic Power.' POSITIVE means a reduction on a _cost_pct key - eight talents across four classes authored these negative and delivered a surcharge.

nodes.name: Harvester
nodes.description: Your damage heals you for 15% of the damage dealt.
nodes._source: CoA's level-10 free passive and the whole reason to play the spec: 'You now heal yourself equal to 15% of all damage dealt', 'pure lifesteal that trivializes downtime'. Frontier has no free passives, so it is a single-point node early in the tree. One point, not five, because a proc's PAYLOAD does not scale with rank and a 5-rank version would read as 75% and deliver 15%.

nodes.name: Blood Fueled
nodes.description: Your Doomrend has a 34% chance per rank to leave the target receiving 30% less healing for 3 turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the healing absorbed by Doomrend by 30%', on top of Doomrend's own 'dark shield to them that absorbs the next healing done to them'. Doomrend itself cannot carry a proc (only buff/debuff abilities do), so the anti-heal lives here, gated to Doomrend with ability_filter. healing_taken_pct is read only through get_status_stat_mod, which is exactly why it has to be a proc's stat_mod and could not be a plain effect.

nodes.name: Genocide
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of Slaughter by 4% and its critical damage by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the critical damage and critical strike chance of Slaughter by 10%.'

nodes.name: Crimson Thirst
nodes.description: Your strikes have a 15% chance per rank to build Crimson Thirst, increasing your damage by 4% for 3 turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Physical damage dealt now grants Crimson Thirst for 20 seconds, stacking 5 times ... Your next Murder deals 10% increased damage and costs -10% less per stack. At 5 stacks, it also heals you equal to 50% of the damage dealt.' max_stacks=5 is real here - a stacking effect's stat_mods are PER STACK. The Murder-only targeting and the 5-stack heal are dropped; Harvester already carries the spec's leech.

nodes.name: Souls for the Slaughter
nodes.description: Your critical strikes have a 25% chance per rank to leave Shadow rot on the target for 2 turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Critical strikes with Slaughter now cause your auto attacks to deal an additional 85% Shadow damage for 5 seconds.' Added Shadow damage on autoattacks has no hook, so the Shadow goes onto the target as a dot instead. Not filtered to Slaughter: Slaughter only fires under 35% health, and a proc that can only roll during an execute window is a dead talent in practice.

nodes.name: Hungering Scythe
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Crow's Harvest by 6% per rank, and your Deathwind lasts 1 turn longer.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the duration of Deathwind by 4 sec and Crow's Harvest now deals 15% additional damage to enemies inside.' The 'inside Deathwind' condition is not modellable without zones, so the damage bonus is unconditional and smaller. Capped at 2 ranks because ability_<id>_duration is flat turns and three extra turns would double a 3-turn heal.

nodes.name: Ravenous Thirst
nodes.description: Reduces the Mana cost of Ghastly Screech and Soul Strike by 6% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Reduces the Runic Power cost of Ghastly Screech and Soul Strike by -10.' Flat 10 of a Runic Power bar becomes a percentage of a Mana cost that grows with rank.

nodes.name: The Time Has Come
nodes.description: Increases all damage you deal by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your abilities now deal 10% more damage against slowed targets.' Nothing reads a target's slow state in the damage path, so the condition is dropped and the bonus shrinks to match - the spec does run Harvesting Grounds and Ghost Claw, so in practice the targets usually are slowed.

nodes.name: Hemorrhage
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Slaughter by 8% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the damage and critical strike chance of your abilities by 10% against enemies below 35% health.' _damage_multiplier has no recipient, so there is no way to read the TARGET's health there. Landed on Slaughter, which is already gated to 35% - the same window, reached honestly.

nodes.name: Crimson Death
nodes.description: Your strikes have a 10% chance per rank to repeat Slaughter at no cost.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Slaughter now has a 20% chance to cast an additional time free of cost.' cast_ability is a real proc payload. Deliberately NOT filtered to Slaughter, because Slaughter's own execute gate already decides whether the free cast lands - the roll happens on any strike and only pays out on a target under 35%.

nodes.name: Harvest Time
nodes.description: Teaches Harvest Time: for 3 turns your damage and critical strike chance both rise by 15%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Harvest Time (and the Blood Frenzy it unleashes) as your burst window when you can commit to a heavy trade.'

nodes.name: Darkrend Scythe
nodes.description: Doomrend and Crow's Harvest have a 40% chance per rank to open a bleed, dealing damage over 3 turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Damage dealt by Doomrend and Crow's Harvest now applies a bleed, dealing AP Physical damage every 2 sec for 10 seconds, stacking 5 times.' Filtered to those two abilities exactly as written. Physical-schooled, so it reads as a bleed; the 5-stack version is dropped.

nodes.name: Deathbringer
nodes.description: Your Harvest Time and Blood Frenzy each last 1 turn longer per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the duration of Blood Frenzy and Harvest Time by 100%.' Two ranks on a 3-turn window is close enough to doubling it.

nodes.name: Shudder Scythe
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Murder by 8% and its critical strike chance by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Murder is transformed into Shudder Scythe ... Strike an enemy 5 times, each dealing 30% Weapon Damage ... and granting you a Soul Fragment with each strike.' An ability transform is not expressible, so the transform's upside lands on Murder directly.

nodes.name: Blood Frenzy
nodes.description: Teaches Blood Frenzy, and increases your physical damage by 8%. The longer the fight runs, the worse it goes for them.
nodes._source: Capstone. CoA puts Blood Frenzy at its own top tier, 'your all-in button for extended trades' - and the spec blurb is literally 'The longer the fight runs, the worse it goes for the enemy', which is why the capstone is sustained damage rather than a burst window.
